source: Uploaded user-generated EMIT and Sentinel-2 CSVs plus integration report; independent NASA-source checksum not verified
study_area: Egypt Nile Delta 3x3 km; projected EPSG:32636
stricter_coverage_rule: at least 5 valid EMIT pixels AND at least 50% valid EMIT pixel-center coverage, exploratory sensitivity rule not a calibrated quality standard

environmental_predictors.note: same satellite date for all fields; no independent cross-field variation in these modeled environmental variables

cautions: No independent crop stress, dust damage, or drought labels
Only three matched geographic training fields (one under stricter filter): avoid supervised hyperspectral stress-classification claims
Ten fields have conflicting legacy vs audited splits; use field_split
Field polygons are FTW predictions; not independent land-survey ground truth
Same-AOI comparison is not same-pixel/same-date sensor validation: different spatial resolutions and aggregation statistics
Eight wavelength channels are uniformly missing in raw field medians; retained complete-case spectra exclude them
Most modeled environmental covariates are constant across the 14 field rows at one date
Original NASA granule checksum and raw L2A mask/uncertainty independent verification not established by provided files
